correctness.rationale: This pass is for repairs/4/RESULT.md. The frozen proof inferred a fixed-target count as a→0 from eventual grid stabilization at each fixed a, without controlling when stabilization occurs; also, the source's tolerance must qualify the phrase 'any fixed reduction'. The repair proves the full target count uniformly from the first step and explicitly restricts targets to those above the source tolerance. From δ_0=1 and the positive accepted length, v_k=a u_k with u_k=(α_k+α_k/η)q_k≠0 whenever the algorithm executes a step. Its update (20) is v_k²/(v_k u_k)=a. Test (21) divided by a²s_k² is exactly A(a)α²−Bα−χ_k/2≤0; the single positive root gives the first accepted r^m. The threshold tends from above to B/A without any monotonicity requirement. The next larger grid point is eventually rejected, whereas the limiting accepted point always passes, even in the grid-equality case. If reached, the stabilized step has 0<Bα<2 and hence modulus below one; for small a, rB/A<α≤B/A=Θ(a²), giving the stated factor and log index. Uniformly before stabilization, rB/A≤α_k≤B/A+√(χ_k/(2A))=O(a²+a√χ_k). For fixed summable sequence of sum S and small a this gives Bα_k≤1/2 at every calibrated step. Using x≤−log(1−x)≤2x and Cauchy–Schwarz, the total log drop after N calibrated steps is bounded below by c a²N and above by C(a+a²N+a√(NS)); the initial step drops only O(a) on the log scale. These bounds give both constants in Θ(a^(−2)) for every fixed target strictly above 10^(−5) and below 1, and the stopping rule cannot prevent reaching that target. No finite run is assumed to have visited a stabilized index.

value.rationale: The scalar family is a motivated scale diagnostic: all starts have the same nonzero residual and every Jacobian has condition number one. After a single executed step the update has already found the true slope, yet the published search rules enforce a polynomial increase in work to a physically identical residual target. The precise order is useful for interpreting or testing scale robustness of the actual algorithm; it is stronger than an eventual multiplier alone, which could be irrelevant before stopping. The repair retains that finite-work conclusion without crediting a mechanism already shared by another method.
residual_risks: This is a scalar exact-arithmetic obstruction, not a general problem complexity theorem, a claim of divergence, or a recommendation to remove a convergence penalty.
